name: @pipeworx/mcp-fbi-crime

tools.name: list_agencies
tools.description: List reporting agencies (police departments / sheriffs) for a state. Returns ORI (Originating Reporting Identifier) — the canonical agency ID required by the other tools.

state_abbr.description: 2-letter state code (e.g., "CA"). Required: as of mid-2026 the all-agencies endpoint is gone and the API requires a state filter.

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Fetch a single agency record by ORI. Resolved by listing the agencies for the ORI's state and filtering — the dedicated by-ORI endpoint was retired mid-2026.

ori.description: 9-character ORI (e.g., "CA0194200" = LAPD). First two chars are the state code.

tools.name: national_estimate
tools.description: National summarized counts + rates for an offense across a date range. Useful for "how has X crime trended nationally".

from.description: Start month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (defaults to Jan, 5 years ago)

to.description: End month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (defaults to current month)

tools.name: state_summary
tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense in a state. Returns time-series and totals.

from.description: Start month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (default 5 years ago)

to.description: End month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (default current)

tools.name: agency_summary
tools.description: Summarized monthly counts of an offense for one agency (by ORI). Returns time-series of victims/incidents/offenders.

from.description: Start month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY

to.description: End month: MM-YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY

tools.name: list_offense_slugs
tools.description: List the offense slugs accepted by national_estimate / state_summary / agency_summary. Returns a static list.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fbi-crime forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fbi-crime pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
